evidence.quote: Last weekend I had an experience that reminded me of the impact we can make. I got to volunteer at a career fair at a local school, and it was incredible to see how lack of resources affects these kids' dreams.

evidence.quote: The sign says, 'Always look on the bright side of life'. It reminds us that kids can reach their dreams with the right help.
